stemMd: Some musicians are hikers. Some hikers are painters. Which assertion is NOT guaranteed?
explanationMd: The hikers who are musicians may be different from the hikers who are painters. The two overlaps do not require any musician-painter overlap.

distractorRationale.e: Each existential premise guarantees a hiker.
distractorRationale.d: The first premise guarantees a musician.
